title: Optimizing Canaries for Privacy Auditing with Metagradient Descent
abstract: arXiv:2507.15836v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this work we study black-box privacy auditing, where the goal is to lower bound the privacy parameter of a differentially private learning algorithm using only the algorithm's outputs (i.e., final trained model). For DP-SGD (the most successful method for training differentially private deep learning models), the canonical auditing approach uses membership inference - an auditor comes with a small set of special "canary" examples, inserts a random subset of them into the training set, and then tries to discern which of their canaries were included in the training set (typically via a membership inference attack). The auditor's success rate then provides a lower bound on the privacy parameters of the learning algorithm. Our main contribution is a method for optimizing the auditor's canary set to improve privacy auditing, leveraging recent work on metagradient optimization (Engstrom et al., 2025). translated_title: 利用元梯度下降优化隐私审计中的金丝雀样本
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们研究了黑盒隐私审计，其目标是仅利用学习算法的输出（即最终训练好的模型）来为差分隐私学习算法的隐私参数提供下界。对于DP-SGD（训练差分隐私深度学习模型最成功的方法），标准的审计方法采用成员推断——审计者准备一组特殊的“金丝雀”样本，将其中一个随机子集插入训练集，然后尝试辨别哪些金丝雀样本被包含在训练集中（通常通过成员推断攻击实现）。审计者的成功率随后为学习算法的隐私参数提供了一个下界。我们的主要贡献是提出了一种优化审计者金丝雀样本集的方法，以改进隐私审计，该方法利用了近期关于元梯度优化的研究成果（Engstrom et al., 2025）。我们的实证评估表明……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用元梯度下降来优化隐私审计中金丝雀样本集的构造，从而更有效地对DP-SGD等差分隐私学习算法的隐私参数进行黑盒下界估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes optimizing the auditor's canary set via metagradient descent to strengthen black-box privacy auditing of DP-SGD by providing tighter lower bounds on its privacy parameters.
